body:
Implements build item 1 of docs/specs/operating-stack.md (§8a, §9.1) — the WRITE side of per-phase token-spend recording. The READ side already exists: packages/gate-manifest/lib/spend.mjs defines the usage contract `{ inputTokens, outputTokens, cachedTokens, provider, model, tier }` and `aggregateSpend(entries)` aggregates it byPhase/byGate. Nothing currently populates `usage` on real manifest entries, so aggregation always sees zeros.

PRODUCER BOUNDARY (load-bearing — a prior draft of this ticket scoped usage wiring to packages that make no model calls; do not repeat that): packages/prosecute makes ZERO model calls itself — P5 prosecution consumes EXTERNAL review packets (`adlc-prosecute --input passes.json`), and packages/runner only validates evidence. The real in-repo model callers go through @adlc/core's llm layer (packages/core/lib/llm.mjs, which already normalizes provider usage blocks to the spend.mjs field names): coldstart, spec-lint --llm, premortem, parallax, preflight, lesson-foundry. Therefore usage must enter the manifest through TWO real paths:
1. External-review path (P5): extend the review-packet schema (packages/prosecute/lib/schema.mjs) with an OPTIONAL validated `usage` object per pass, using the spend.mjs field names verbatim; prosecute's manifest record path copies a valid `usage` onto the entries it records and omits it cleanly when absent. Invalid usage shapes are rejected with a named validation error (fail closed on garbage, tolerate absence).
2. Core-caller path (P4 and gate calls): thread the normalized usage returned by @adlc/core's llm layer into the gate-manifest entries recorded by callers that both invoke a model and record manifest evidence. Wire coldstart (packages/coldstart/lib/gate.mjs) as the reference producer in this ticket; other core callers may follow the same seam in follow-on work.
Entries additionally accept three OPTIONAL sibling fields alongside `usage` (not inside it): `channel`, `transport`, `registryDigest` (mandatory only for quartermaster-dispatched calls once T151's registry lands); record them when supplied, omit cleanly otherwise; aggregateSpend must remain byte-compatible (it ignores siblings).

Acceptance criteria (all tests drive the REAL producer paths — constructing manifest entries by hand in the round-trip test is a test-integrity failure):
- Packet path: an `adlc-prosecute --input <passes.json>` run whose fixture packet carries per-pass `usage` produces manifest entries whose `usage` flows through `aggregateSpend()` to nonzero P5 `byPhase` totals; the same run with usage absent records entries without `usage` and aggregates to zero without error; a malformed usage shape is rejected naming the field. Verified by `packages/prosecute/test/usage-packet.test.mjs` (assert on totals, absence tolerance, and rejection).
- Core-caller path: coldstart's gate path, driven with a stubbed provider response carrying a provider-native usage block, records a manifest entry whose `usage` matches core's normalization output; aggregateSpend over it is nonzero. Verified by `packages/gate-manifest/test/usage-roundtrip.test.mjs` (assert on normalized fields and totals).
- Sibling fields: an entry recorded with `{channel, transport, registryDigest}` preserves them verbatim and `aggregateSpend()` output is identical with and without them. Verified by cases in `packages/gate-manifest/test/usage-roundtrip.test.mjs` (assert on entry fields and aggregate equality).
- No-usage providers: a core-caller record with a null/absent provider usage block writes zeroed `usage` and increments `calls`. Verified by a case in `packages/gate-manifest/test/usage-roundtrip.test.mjs` (assert calls===1, tokens===0).
- Schema guard: `packages/gate-manifest/lib/spend.mjs` is unchanged (rail); full gate-manifest and prosecute test segments green. Verified via `node scripts/run-tests.mjs` exit code 0 for those segments.

Context: docs/specs/operating-stack.md §8a defines the telemetry contract; GitHub issue #272 tracks the gap. The spec is a rail — implement to it, do not amend it in this ticket.
title: Record per-phase usage on gate-manifest entries via the REAL producer paths (spend write side, #272)
